title: Outcome Row
description: one row of index/by_outcome.jsonl: everything an app needs to answer one question type - the quesited house, its rulers, the source's own ruling table, the passages, and how many attributed voices stand behind each of it

always_read.description: techniques that must be evaluated for any reading, not only on request

base_rates.description: observed answer rates for this house over all 65,536 casts

cal_scope.description: the scope statement of the source's own table for this house

coverage_note.description: plain statement of what is covered, including when nothing is

disagreeing_keys.description: keys where two works measurably lean differently

extra_houses.description: houses that must be read alongside this one

label.description: human label from the house register

latin.description: the house's Latin name in the source register

n_passages_for_house.description: total passages for this house (passages is capped at 30)

n_voice_keys.description: claim keys in the voice index that speak to this outcome

n_voices.description: attributed voice rows behind those keys

n_works.description: how many distinct works (1 means single-source, and should be shown as such)

outcome.description: question-type key the app asked for

passages.description: passage ids in the shards that speak to this house

quesited_house.description: house number the question falls in (1-12)

quote_available.description: how many of those voices may be quoted verbatim under licence

ruling_table.description: figure -> ruling, exactly as the source tabulates it

significator_rules.description: the ordering of rules an app should apply to this outcome

triplicities.description: triplicity groups the source assigns to this house

voice_keys.description: the claim keys themselves, capped at 40

voices.description: voice ids to pass to engine/ground.py, capped at 40

works.description: which works those voices come from
